name: Kaguya Otsutsuki
description: (Tag:character)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:space)(Character)Kaguya Otsutsuki is the Rabbit Goddess and Progenitor of Chakra who ate the Chakra Fruit for truly godlike power. She can manipulate all chakra natures, create Truth-seeking Balls, absorb energy including from living beings, use disintegrating All-Killing Ash Bones and the Rinne Sharingan, and warp space to create and travel pocket dimensions.
